column1: # ci = under ~3 min with 4-8 workers (TLC v1.7.4); full = longer.  See README.md.
# v1.7.4 prints liveness violations as "Temporal properties were violated."
# Record design: one fix off at a time
# Fully amended design (A1-A6), epochs <= 2, one fault kind per run: exhaustive
# Unguarded host-loss release (no epoch bound, no lost re-check) - a model
# variant, not the code (main has both guards), same bound
# Current design (82396b3 / main): no same-host re-issue, never adopt, tick
# expiry re-checked (N1 fixed), host loss epoch-bounded and re-checked;
# epochs <= 2, one fault kind.  The full-tier results in the pilot report were
# taken before the two host-loss guards were added (a weaker release).
# drain: no violation through BFS depth ~40 (72.2M states) but never finished
# (60 min, shared box out of memory) - expected holds, not confirmed
# wedge alone is vacuous at one fault; restart + wedge (2 faults) has teeth
# Previous-release host closure: h2 seeded with a live brain
# C6 (regression): both host-loss guards off at epochs <= 3, zero faults.
# Partial (cut at 15 min, no violation found): one host-loss guard alone,
# the epochs <= 3 sweep (depth-bounded, ~34-44), and liveness (explored part
# only).  MC_nr_live_crash / _lost have not been run.
# An operator's restart split as the code is (intent, then the condemn after AgentDO's awaits), 2026-11-10.
# One host: the restart and the turn race on one brain.
